# jumpcloud_user_group_membership (Resource)

Manages membership of a user in a JumpCloud user group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jumpcloud_user_group_membership" "example" {
  group_id = jumpcloud_user_group.engineering.id
  user_id  = "64a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The ID of the user group.
- `user_id` (String) The ID of the user to add to the group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID in the format group_id/user_id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import jumpcloud_user_group_membership.example <group-id>/<user-id>
```
